$comment: publicUtilities: classes shipped for consumers to pass through props (tableMinHeightClassName, tableMaxHeightClassName, boardMinHeightClassName). hookOnly: structural hooks (thead, tbody, icons, wrappers) the library writes on purpose without any default declaration, so consumers can target them; the audit checks they are emitted and never gain a rule silently. variantAttributes: attributes whose value comes from a prop (data-variant={variant}); a selector on them is checked by attribute name plus the value as a string literal in the sources. runtimeAttributes: attributes set by Radix or react-day-picker at runtime, never written in a component. hostAttributes: data attributes the host app sets to configure the library (theme activation).
